setup.title: Course Setup
setup.subtitle: Manage course categories and course types from one place.
setup.name: Name
setup.nameNeedsLetters: The name must contain letters or numbers

category.description: Organize courses by subject area so students can browse learning paths faster.

courseType.description: Define what students can learn, such as live courses, recorded courses, seminars, and language tracks.

title: Homepage Header Showcase
subtitle: Manage the public header logo and image-only homepage slider posts.

logo.title: Site logo
logo.hint: Upload one public logo for the website header. Recommended size: 320 x 96 px transparent PNG or WebP.
logo.chooseHint: Select a clean horizontal logo. Uploading a new file replaces the current logo.

posts.title: Header slider images
posts.hint: Recommended upload size: 2048 x 460 px or the same wide banner ratio. Actual dimensions are shown on each image after upload.
posts.dragHint: Drag the handle (or use Move Up / Move Down in the menu) to change the slider order.

form.chooseMany: Choose one or more banner images
form.sizeHint: Recommended full header image size: 2048px wide x 460px high. Use compressed JPG/WebP images for faster homepage loading.
form.publishAtHint: Public images with a future schedule appear automatically after this date and time.
form.orderHint: Lower numbers appear first in the homepage slider.
form.orderInvalid: Enter a whole number (0 or more)

file.badType: {{name}} is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP image
file.tooMany: Choose at most {{max}} images at once
